sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Flesh-eater Courts army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Flesh-eater Courts units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Choose an Archetype.
4. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
5. Choose a Battle Mount.
6. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Cannibal Courtier | 10 | 150
Ghoulish Earl | 30 | 250
Abhorrant Duke | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.name: Step 3 - Choose an Archetype
sections.text:
You must pick 1 of the following Archetypes for your hero:
Landed Noble
0DP
Your hero has the NOBLE keyword and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any SERFS or KNIGHTS units
Ushorite Cleric
-4DP
Your hero has the PRIEST (1) and ABHORRANT keywords and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any FLESH-EATER COURTS units
Blooded Royalty
-6DP
Your hero gains the WIZARD (1) and ABHORRANT keywords and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any FLESH-EATER COURTS units
In addition, replace your hero’s melee weapon with the following weapon:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Sharpened Talons and Fangs | 5 | 3+ | 3+ | 1 | 2

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.text:

Effect: Add 10 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective that is not being contested by any other friendly units.

-4DP
BLIND TO THE WORLD
Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.
Passive
-4DP

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:
Passive

Effect: This unit cannot use commands while it is in combat.

Effect: In your charge phase, if this unit is not in combat and there is an enemy unit within 12" of it, this unit must use a CHARGE ability, and if the charge roll would allow it to end the move within ½" of an enemy unit, it must do so.

+4DP
COURT PARIAH
Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.
Passive

OLD VALOUR WOUND
Effect: Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks.

sections.name: Step 5 - Choose a Battle Mount
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Battle Mount for your hero.
Battle Mount
-5DP
NIGHTSHRIEKER: This stooped, bat-like monster is drawn straight from the champion’s personal stables.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Nightshrieker’s Claws and Teeth
Companion | 3 | 4+ | 3+ | 1 | 2
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 12".
Change the Health characteristic to 8.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the following keywords: CAVALRY, FLY.
Battle Mount
-20DP

sections.name: Step 6 - Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades
sections.text:
If your hero has a Battle Mount, you can pick any number of Battle Mount Upgrades for them. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.
Upgrade | Effect
Regal Presence
-2DP
Add the following ability to your hero's warscroll:
Passive
REGAL PRESENCE
Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
Speed of Undeath
-3DP
Add 2" to your hero's Move characteristic.
Vile Exhalation
-3DP
CAVALRY only. Add the following ranged weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
RANGED WEAPONS | Rng | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg

Infested Corpse
-5DP
Add the following ability to your hero's warscroll:
Passive
INFESTED CORPSE
Effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a D3 for each enemy unit in combat with it. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
Preferred Prey
-4DP
CAVALRY only. Your hero’s Companion melee weapons have Anti-X (+1 Rend), where X is a faction keyword or 1 of the following keywords: INFANTRY, CAVALRY, MONSTER, WAR MACHINE, HERO, WIZARD or PRIEST.
Powerful Maw
-6DP
MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll. You cannot pick this upgrade if your hero has another RAMPAGE ability.
Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
POWERFUL MAW
Declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: You and your opponent must each roll 2D6. If you roll higher, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between your roll and your opponent’s roll.
KEYWORDS | RAMPAGE

Passive
MEMORIES OF HATE

Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Companion melee weapons.
Subtract 1 from save rolls for this unit.
Magnificent Monstrosity
-10DP
MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll. You cannot pick this upgrade if your hero has another RAMPAGE ability.
Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
MAGNIFICENT MONSTROSITY
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.
Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
KEYWORDS | RAMPAGE

sections.name: Path of Royalty
sections.text:
(FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
SKILL-AT-ARMS
Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
Passive
UNNATURAL PARRY
Effect: Combat attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
UNNATURAL WARDS
Effect: This unit has WARD (4+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.
Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
UNHOLY THIRST
Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including Companion weapons, for the rest of the turn.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
LET US BREAK BREAD!
Effect: Enemy units cannot use RETREAT abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
Passive
GLORIOUS CHARGE
Effect: When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Turn (Army) Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for an enemy unit within 12" of this unit
REGAL AUTHORITY
Effect: You and your opponent must roll off. If you roll higher, subtract 3 from the charge roll. If your roll is at least double your opponent’s roll, pick 1 dice in the charge roll instead. Your opponent must remove that dice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
BELOVED OF THE KINGDOM
Declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE FLESH-EATER COURTS unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

sections.name: Path of The Subjects
sections.text:
(non-HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS unit only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Start of Battle Round
ROVING PACK
Effect: If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit can move 3". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
Any Combat Phase
SENTRIES-AT-ARMS
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
End of Any Turn
CULINARY ARTISTES
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit and that have any damage points allocated to them to be the targets.
Effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on each target.
Passive
ONE WITH THE LAND
Effect: While this unit is wholly within 3" of a terrain feature, it is not visible to enemy units more than 6" away.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
GUARDS OF THE ROYAL MENAGERIE
Effect: Subtract 2 from the Damage characteristic of Companion weapons used for attacks that target this unit.
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
GLORY OR DEATH
Effect: For the rest of the turn:
Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including Companion weapons.
This unit cannot contest objectives.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, it gains the following ability:
Passive
ROYAL ELITE
Effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).
Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
FAMED PILGRIMS
Effect: Return D6 slain models to this unit.
